claim_wording.becomes_available: An outside labour source that the rebuild could use if the link's condition B holds, and that the draw would have to be credited for (E5, E24).
claim_wording.changes: Would give the purchased draw a return-labour function that E2 records it does not carry; the change holds only under the undefined condition B (inferred).
claim_wording.development: Mill Compact (d2): Oona Brisk offers hired lowland labour, credited against the Compact's draw; the offer is neither accepted nor refused.

result.reasoning: E2 (established) states that the purchased draw carries no return labour; an offer is not stated in E2. E24 gives a link only under B, which the cited items do not define. The offer appears only in E5, agent_proposed Working Book text whose naming of Oona Brisk is deferred to another item. The claim's development text states that offer in present tense as a Mill Compact record, and its basis 'inferred' does not cover it, since the offer is not inferred from E2 or E24. The conditional wording of becomes_available and changes is sound.
result.quote: Oona Brisk and the Mill Compact (named in the source; see unk-character-sourcing) offer hired lowland labour if it is credited against the Compact's draw.
result.alternative_reading: The quote is copied from E5, which is agent_proposed text, so it does not carry a record premise. An offer is not stated in E2, and E5 defers the naming of Oona Brisk to another item. Read as a proposal, the offer stays open; read as the Mill Compact's record, the attribution has no support in the cited items.
result.would_settle: A cited item that records the hired-labour offer as Mill Compact development and names Oona Brisk, plus a defined condition B for the link in E24.
result.creative_room: Still open: a hired-labour offer credited against the draw, with its settlement author-reserved (E5); a defined condition B under which the draw owes grain-labour (E24). Treat as proposals, not record: Oona Brisk's offer, its crediting against the draw, and any outside labour source in Book 24.
